node.title: KoalaBear m2 r4 coordinate coefficient normal form
node.closure: two exhaustive 8/7-dimensional parity source forms, nonzero deck-odd part, and even endpoint quadratic norm
node.statement: For an actual component stabilized by tau x 1, geometric coordinates tau(T)=-T and b(X)=-X make the bidegree-(2,4) source equation an eigenform under (T,X)->(-T,-X). The positive form is A_2(W)T^2+A_0(W)+XTB_1(W), of dimension 8; the negative form is TA_1(W)+X(B_2(W)T^2+B_0(W)), of dimension 7. Deck distinction requires nonzero odd-X part, and the endpoint norm G=U^2-WV^2 is even in T. This is an exact coordinate-branch coefficient test, not a universal exclusion.
